name: nomi
description: Thin client for Nomi reviewable agents — approve plans and tool calls without leaving the editor.

nomi.apiUrl.description: Override nomid base URL (default: read api.endpoint from the Nomi data dir, else http://127.0.0.1:8080).

nomi.token.description: Override bearer token (default: $NOMI_TOKEN or auth.token in the Nomi data dir). Prefer the Secret Storage command for remote hosts.

nomi.dataDir.description: Override Nomi data directory (default: $NOMI_DATA_DIR or OS app-data path).

nomi.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to refresh the pending badge when SSE is unavailable.

nomi.defaultAssistantId.description: Assistant ID used by Nomi: Run with editor context. Leave empty to pick from a Quick Pick.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/discovery.test.js out/editor_context.test.js
